title: Reflex Classifier (Qwen3-0.6B, GGUF-native cold-start inference)
description: Zero-shot classification and intent routing with an open-weight Qwen3-0.6B (Q8_0, baked into the image). Send a job with a `prompt` and `labels`; Reflex scores every label as a continuation of the prompt in one prefill and returns each label's probability within the set plus the entropy -- nothing is generated, so a decision is one forward pass, not a decode loop. Also serves OpenAI-compatible chat completions, streaming or not. Backed by Reflex: a GGUF-native GPU inference engine built for fast cold starts (ahead-of-time compiled CUDA kernels, no runtime JIT).

input.name: Adapter Arguments
input.description: Extra reflex-openai-adapter flags, space-separated, e.g. "--max-tokens-cap 1024 --default-max-tokens 128". Request limits default to max_tokens 2048, prompt 256 KiB, queue depth 16, timeout 300 s.
